title: Where I've built.
sub: Four roles, one throughline: own the system end-to-end, not just the ticket.

roles.title: Software Development Engineer
roles.summary: Owned end-to-end development of financial infrastructure for Nym4Business, serving SMEs across the MENA region.
bullets: Owned end-to-end development (backend, frontend, database) of features for Nym4Business, a multi-tenant B2B platform providing financial infrastructure to SMEs and organizations.
Developed a configurable approval-rule engine supporting custom transaction conditions (amount, type, sender/recipient) with multi-approver logic across roles and individuals.
Shipped two-factor authentication and audit logging integrated with NymCard's core payment systems, plus dashboards and GraphQL APIs for role-based data access.
Collaborated with security teams to ensure compliance with financial regulations and strict data privacy standards across multi-tenant environments.

roles.title: Software Development Engineer
roles.summary: Architected core microservices for Korn Ferry Talent Suite, serving enterprise clients in 150+ countries.
bullets: Developed core backend services (NestJS) powering Korn Ferry Talent Suite, a global HR-tech platform serving thousands of organizations across 150+ countries.
Designed an internal-routing system for inter-service communication, reducing inter-service latency by up to 70% and overall latency by up to 40%, with no handler code changes required.
Built a streaming export system for multi-gigabyte audit-log CSVs, reconstructing data in real time to minimize server memory use and eliminate storage costs.
Designed an advanced request-tracing system delivering detailed traces, including database and HTTP calls, with zero added overhead in response pipelines.

roles.title: Founding Engineer & Technical Lead
roles.summary: Led technical design and engineering from pre-seed to production for a high-concurrency rental marketplace.
bullets: Founding engineer and technical lead for a rental marketplace; architected and owned the majority of backend and desktop UI, leading a team of three from initial design through production deployment.

Designed a hybrid geolocation and address-based search system (map, radius, and structured address queries) alongside an extensible, inheritance-based CMS giving granular per-category control over listing fields, pricing packages, and limits.
Built a real-time chat and notification system with per-listing conversation identity, live presence, and real-time listing updates.
Built a Stripe-integrated wallet and auto-renewal payment system with a hybrid ledger (direct payments and credits) and hash-locked transaction immutability.

roles.title: Full-Stack Developer
roles.summary: Delivered custom web applications for clients worldwide while mentoring aspiring engineers.
bullets: Built full-stack web applications for clients across 20+ countries, including a gaming-focused social platform, a video conferencing app, and an interactive coding education tool.
Provided technical mentorship to 100+ developers across the full skill spectrum, from teaching absolute beginners to advising working professionals on system design and backend architecture.
